title: Vesper and the Vector
author: Mirabel Nakamura
blurb: Isandro Lockridge, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
